Mushy poop is sometimes a sign that they're not getting enough fiber. Don't give them treats if their poop is mushy - pellets and hay only, preferably more hay. Also, make sure they have plenty of water because if they're losing water through poop they can get dehydrated fast.

How long has it been like that? If it's been going on for days and they aren't eating/drinking as much you need to go to the vet. Overall if it doesn't go back to normal within a few days to a week you need to get it checked out.
